policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance short-stay visa
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's MFA expressly requires a visa for Afghan citizens and its governing short-stay procedure requires filing with the competent diplomatic or consular mission.
conditions: Submit the visitor-visa application to the competent Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic or consular mission according to the applicant's residence. The ordinary Afghan-nationality entry row requires a visa.

The narrow individual emergency border-visa provisions do not establish a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route. Passport recognition, mission operation, residence, work, transit, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Afghan ordinary passports: Kosovo advance short-stay visa
policies.summary: Kosovo's current closed visa-exemption list does not include Afghanistan, and its Foreign Ministry requires other foreign nationals to use the in-person diplomatic or consular visa process before a visit.
conditions: Submit the short-stay visa application in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission no later than three months before the intended visit. Afghanistan is not in the current official exemption list, and no listed special-category exemption is inferred here.

This is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route. Passport recognition, mission availability, transit, residence, work, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.
